tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Adam is 13.9-0.0 on Corbishley early. Helix is a $70.25 stock. Apex is a $125.49 stock. Early scores are early scores — but the Ledger remembers every single one of them.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Ryan at $124.14 on the exchange, 9-11 in the standings, and currently edging Brent 3.2-0.0 in a game that means almost nothing for the top of the bracket — the defending champion is playing for seeding survival while the market prices him like a contender.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Three teams knotted at 15-5, one of them trailing a 10-10 Monarch squad, another getting run off the field by a team that relocated to Havana — the Ledger is going to have a lot of material this week and we have not even hit the first full quarter.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Jake over Drew before the week started and Drew is currently at 4.0 to Jake's 0.0, which means the roster is doing exactly what I said it would do — it just happens to be doing it from behind, which is on brand for this matchup and not a problem for my thesis.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 is a number that does not fully capture the context of the situations I was working with, and I think a fair-minded person would acknowledge that before simply reading the record aloud.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season and I am watching Terrence sitting at 5-7 like it is a normal outcome and not a catastrophe that deserves its own postmortem segment — give me twenty minutes and a whiteboard and I will walk through every single one of those seven misses.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: I ranked Kevin fourth and called him the most fragile 13-5 in the league. I ranked Jake ninth and said the TE room would be the ceiling. Both of those theses are currently live on a Saturday morning and I will not be taking questions from anyone who had Kevin top-three two weeks ago.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Wingard is somehow up 0.0-6.5 on Mitchum right now, and I need everyone who called that matchup a formality to sit with it for a second.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: CHARLES IS TRAILING SHAQ 0.0-3.9 AND THE THREE-WAY TIE AT 15-5 IS ALREADY DOING THINGS. CROWNLINE. CHAMPIONSHIP OR BUST. TRAILING MONARCH. EARLY.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Fronge leads Kevin 39.8-8.8 in the early going of week 11. Redline sold 2027 capital to win now. The scoreboard is currently offering a dissenting opinion.
